pricing.details: Free 0 € — 1 resume, 1 AI interview, 3 PDF downloads, standard-format templates, AI Resume Writer and Editor, no payment required. Pro 26 €/month — unlimited resumes, unlimited AI interviews, unlimited PDF downloads, all templates, AI Writer and Editor, Rezi Score, keyword targeting. Enterprise 90 €/month per 200 users — everything in Pro plus education videos, domain restriction, SSO, team roles and related admin features (book a demo).
